name: admin
description: Generic admin shell — landing page scaffold + Convex admin probe query (isAdmin / counts). Consumer composes feature panels into the grid. Gated by requireAdmin on Convex side.
notes: No own schema — relies on consumer mounting feature-specific panels (users, content, audit-log, etc.). Route /admin auth-guarded; superadmin email gate via SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL convex env.
